title: The Hollow Ember
author: L. M. Okafor
blurb: Cyrus Sandoval, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
